_why: Skill-candidates row `a re-dispatched auditor gets a SUFFIXED report path, never the original's` (2026-10-05): two re-dispatched audit legs were handed the original legs' report paths, one clobber and one near-clobber, because both originals were alive and slow and were declared dead from a hook's Running: set (#49o). Claim once, never release (round 3), tightened in round 4: the assembler claims an absolute `--report-file` with an O_EXCL marker under $XDG_CACHE_HOME/h-mad/handed (keyed by realpath parent + casefolded name), refuses an existing report or prompt path, writes the prompt with O_EXCL, and derives --out from RP (appending `.txt` unless RP ends `.report.md`), refuses an --out that is RP; a reused path HALTs `report_path_handed` naming which was held and deletes nothing; `audit-cycle` mints a fresh stem per run. Each row breaks one of those properties.

mutations.name: rehand-is-staged
mutations._mechanism: The claim's verdict is ignored, so a path handed before is handed again: the #49o clobber.

mutations.name: claim-is-not-exclusive
mutations._mechanism: A plain create succeeds over an existing claim, so every re-hand (and every concurrent hand) passes.

mutations.name: existing-report-path-is-staged
mutations._mechanism: A report path that already exists on disk is claimed and handed as if fresh.

mutations.name: existing-prompt-path-is-not-checked-up-front
mutations._mechanism: The round-3 must-fix: a re-dispatch with a new RP and the live leg's --out gets as far as a claim before anything notices the prompt path.

mutations.name: prompt-is-not-written-exclusively
mutations._mechanism: A prompt path that appears after the check is overwritten: a live leg's prompt now names another leg's report path.
mutations.find: with open(out, "x", encoding="utf-8") as f:  # M:HANDED-OUT-EXCL
mutations.replace: with open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:  # M:HANDED-OUT-EXCL

mutations.name: refused-prompt-keeps-the-claim
mutations._mechanism: When the exclusive prompt write is refused, the report-path claim just made stays, burning a path for a leg never dispatched.

mutations.name: failed-prompt-write-keeps-the-claim
mutations._mechanism: The prompt could not be written but the claim stays, burning the path for a leg that does not exist.

mutations.name: empty-claim-is-left-behind
mutations._mechanism: A claim whose marker line cannot be written stays on disk, holding the path for a leg that was never dispatched.

mutations.name: claim-lives-beside-the-report
mutations._mechanism: The marker is written next to RP, so a docs-path RP leaves a stray file in the project tree.

mutations.name: claim-dir-follows-tmpdir
mutations._mechanism: Keying the directory off TMPDIR lets a sandboxed and an unsandboxed assembler each claim the same RP.
mutations.find: base = Path(xdg) if os.path.isabs(xdg) else Path.home() / ".cache"  # M:HANDED-XDG

mutations.name: home-cache-is-not-the-default
mutations._mechanism: With XDG_CACHE_HOME unset the claim lands in a relative directory (the cwd) instead of ~/.cache.
mutations.find: base = Path(xdg) if os.path.isabs(xdg) else Path.home() / ".cache"  # M:HANDED-XDG

mutations.name: case-spellings-get-two-claims
mutations._mechanism: Without the casefold, two spellings of one file on case-insensitive APFS are claimed twice.

mutations.name: symlinked-spellings-get-two-claims
mutations._mechanism: Without the realpath, `/tmp/x` and `/private/tmp/x` (or a symlinked directory) are claimed twice.

mutations.name: relative-paths-are-accepted
mutations._mechanism: A relative path is hashed against this cwd while the agent resolves it against its own: two cwds, two claims, one file.

mutations.name: relative-prompt-path-is-accepted
mutations._mechanism: Only --report-file is checked, so a relative --out escapes the guard.

mutations.name: prompt-path-is-not-derived-from-the-report-path
mutations._mechanism: Without --out, minting a new RP no longer mints a new prompt path.

mutations.name: derived-prompt-path-replaces-the-extension
mutations._mechanism: Round-4 review: replacing the extension maps `review_x.txt` onto itself, so the prompt is written AT the report path.

mutations.name: prompt-path-may-be-the-report-path
mutations._mechanism: An explicit --out equal to RP is accepted: the report path exists, holding the prompt, before any agent runs.

mutations.name: same-path-check-compares-spellings
mutations._mechanism: Comparing the strings misses two spellings of one file (case, symlink), which the claim key already unifies.

mutations.name: relative-xdg-cache-home-is-honoured
mutations._mechanism: A relative XDG_CACHE_HOME keys the claims off each process's cwd: two cwds, two claim directories.
mutations.find: base = Path(xdg) if os.path.isabs(xdg) else Path.home() / ".cache"  # M:HANDED-XDG
mutations.replace: base = Path(xdg) if xdg else Path.home() / ".cache"  # M:HANDED-XDG

mutations.name: unreadable-path-proceeds
mutations._mechanism: An unmeasured path is read as fresh: the guard fails open exactly when it cannot see.

mutations.name: any-stat-error-reads-as-absent
mutations._mechanism: Treating every OSError as absence is the Python 3.14 `Path.exists` behaviour: EACCES reads as a fresh path.

mutations.name: presence-relies-on-path-exists
mutations._mechanism: Measuring with `Path.exists` works on 3.11 and fails open on 3.14, where it returns False on EACCES.

mutations.name: verb-reuses-one-stem-per-cycle
mutations._mechanism: A fixed per-cycle stem: the second run of a cycle is handed the first run's paths, which the real assembler refuses.

mutations.name: verb-stem-drops-the-pid
mutations._mechanism: Two runs within one clock second share a stem without the pid.
